responsibility: Defines the core base classes and fundamental data structures for Rust HIR. It introduces shared node categories such as Node, Stmt, Item, Expr, Pattern, GenericParam, TraitItem, ImplItem, Crate, PathExpr, and Literal, along with common concepts like Node::BaseKind, source locations, outer attributes, and Analysis::NodeMapping ownership that all concrete HIR nodes build on. This header is the foundation of the Rust HIR object model, upon which the expression, item, path, pattern, statement, and type headers layer their concrete subclasses.
same_name_distinction: Defines the core HIR node classes, enums, and shared data structures that the tree uses, while rust-hir.cc contains the non-inline behavior for those classes such as formatting and visitor dispatch.
